snippet.title: Regions - Dev Diary: Roads (new city building game!)
snippet.description:
Do you like agent based city builders? We do too, and we are building the game of our dreams!

Watch our first quick dev diary about roads!

Wishlist now! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3723230/Regions/

For more info visit https://regions.gg and https://discord.gg/XN6qMQt4sy
